title: 从Java开发者到AI工程师的完整路线图
summary: 该GitHub项目提供从Java开发者转型为AI工程师的分步路线图，涵盖Python、机器学习、深度学习、生成式AI、RAG、Agentic AI、LLM工程、微调、MLOps及生产级AI系统。
summary_en: A step-by-step roadmap for Java developers transitioning to AI engineers, covering Python, ML, deep learning, generative AI, RAG, agentic AI, LLM engineering, fine-tuning, MLOps, and production AI systems.
